Q01:
SELECT u.city AS city,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amt - o.refund_amt), 2) AS net_gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-26' AND o.order_ts < '2026-11-02'
  AND o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY u.city
ORDER BY net_gmv DESC;
Q02:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt - refund_amt) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= '2026-10-26' AND order_ts < '2026-11-02'
  AND status = 'delivered';
Q03:
SELECT substr(order_ts, 1, 10) AS d, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND order_ts < '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d;
Q04:
SELECT u.city AS city,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_new_user = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_user_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_new_user = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS new_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= '2026-10-26' AND o.order_ts < '2026-11-02'
  AND o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY u.city
ORDER BY new_ratio DESC;
Q05:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM users
  WHERE signup_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND signup_ts < '2026-10-26'
),
first7 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id
  FROM cohort u
  JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
   AND o.order_ts >= u.signup_ts
   AND o.order_ts < datetime(u.signup_ts, '+7 days')
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS new_users,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first7) AS ordered_7d,
       ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first7) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 4) AS rate;
Q06:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= '2026-10-26' AND order_ts < '2026-11-02'
    AND status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buyers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS repeat_rate
FROM per_user;
Q07:
SELECT campaign,
       COUNT(*) AS issued,
       SUM(CASE WHEN used_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS used,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN used_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS use_rate
FROM coupons
GROUP BY campaign
ORDER BY use_rate DESC;
Q08:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users
FROM coupons c
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = c.order_id
WHERE c.used_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(c.used_ts) - julianday(c.issued_ts)) * 86400 < 60
  AND o.status = 'refunded';
Q09:
SELECT c.campaign AS campaign,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amt) / SUM(o.gmv), 4) AS discount_share
FROM coupons c
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = c.order_id
WHERE c.used_ts IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.campaign
ORDER BY discount_share DESC;
Q10:
SELECT device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users
FROM devices
GROUP BY device_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 3
ORDER BY users DESC, device_id;
Q11:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.signup_ts >= '2026-10-01' THEN d.user_id END) AS new_users
FROM devices d
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE d.device_id IN ('D900001', 'D900002');
Q12:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ip_days
FROM (
  SELECT order_ip, substr(order_ts, 1, 10) AS d
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ip IS NOT NULL AND order_ip <> ''
  GROUP BY order_ip, d
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 5
);
Q13:
SELECT u.city AS city, ROUND(AVG(d.cnt), 2) AS avg_devices
FROM users u
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS cnt
  FROM devices
  GROUP BY user_id
) d ON d.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.city
ORDER BY avg_devices DESC;
Q14:
SELECT r.city AS city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.rider_id) AS riders,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(COUNT(o.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.rider_id), 2) AS avg_orders
FROM riders r
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.rider_id = r.rider_id
  AND o.status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_ts >= '2026-10-26' AND o.order_ts < '2026-11-02'
GROUP BY r.city
ORDER BY avg_orders DESC;
Q15:
SELECT rider_id,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancel_rate
FROM orders
GROUP BY rider_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY cancel_rate DESC, orders DESC
LIMIT 10;
Q16:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pairs
FROM riders r
JOIN devices d ON d.device_id = r.device_id
WHERE r.device_id IS NOT NULL AND r.device_id <> '';
Q17:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN riders r ON r.rider_id = o.rider_id
JOIN devices d ON d.device_id = r.device_id AND d.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE r.device_id IS NOT NULL AND r.device_id <> '';
Q18:
SELECT merchant_id,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM orders
GROUP BY merchant_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, orders DESC
LIMIT 10;
Q19:
SELECT merchant_id, ROUND(SUM(refund_amt), 2) AS refund_amt
FROM orders
GROUP BY merchant_id
ORDER BY refund_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;
Q20:
SELECT m.category AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amt), 2) AS gmv,
       ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amt) / (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM orders), 4) AS share
FROM orders o
JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id
GROUP BY m.category
ORDER BY gmv DESC;
Q21:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(n) AS orders
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, substr(order_ts, 1, 13) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY user_id, h
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
);
Q22:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'refunded'
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
);
Q23:
WITH multi AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.user_id
  FROM devices d
  JOIN (
    SELECT device_id
    FROM devices
    GROUP BY device_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 3
  ) x ON x.device_id = d.device_id
),
coupon AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id
  FROM coupons c
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = c.order_id
  WHERE c.used_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND (julianday(c.used_ts) - julianday(c.issued_ts)) * 86400 < 60
    AND o.status = 'refunded'
),
vel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY user_id, substr(order_ts, 1, 13)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT user_id FROM multi
  UNION
  SELECT user_id FROM coupon
  UNION
  SELECT user_id FROM vel
);
Q24:
WITH farm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.user_id
  FROM devices d
  WHERE d.device_id IN ('D900001', 'D900002')
),
periods(period, start_ts, end_ts, ord) AS (
  VALUES ('处置前', '2026-10-18', '2026-10-25', 1),
         ('处置后', '2026-10-25', '2026-11-01', 2)
)
SELECT p.period AS period,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS users
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM farm)
  AND o.order_ts >= p.start_ts AND o.order_ts < p.end_ts
GROUP BY p.period, p.ord
ORDER BY p.ord;
